newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on fund buying, seen up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on fund buying, seen up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Monday amid squaring of positions on the last clearing day and on foreign fund buying and dealers said the index might surge on Tuesday on new accounts buying.
They said the index might rise further if national elections set for February 3 were not delayed.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 25.67 points, or 1.74 percent, to end at 1,502.16. Gainers led losers 150 to 101. Turnover fell to 24.82 million shares from 24.87 million on Sunday.
